title: 'Son of man' title taken from the Parables of Enoch

tellings.quote: The proper title the son of man comes from first Enoch specifically from the second section of first Enoch which is called the parables.

plain: Tim Alberino, a researcher, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that the title "son of man," used for Jesus of Nazareth, comes from 1 Enoch, an ancient Jewish religious text, and specifically from its second section, known as the Parables. He also mentions the Book of Daniel, and his point is that the roots of a key Christian title lie in this Enoch writing.
